name: Generation transitions
note: The project's core lens: who is where in each investment-significant generation shift. Stages: development → sampling/qual → first shipments → volume.

tables.title: HBM3E → HBM4
rows: World-first HBM4 mass production Feb 2026 (1c nano); HBM4 >50% of HBM sales from Q3; HBM4E samples Q2 2026 (16Gbps/4.0TB/s)
HBM4 192GB, +33% speed/+20% power eff; demand exceeds supply for 3 years; HBM4E samples H2 2026, MP 2027
HBM4 12-Hi volume ramp 2x faster than HBM3E; >$1B HBM4 revenue shipped; HBM4E ramp 2027
HBM base dies named a driver of the 3-new-fab N3 expansion; 2026 capex raised to $60-64bn with 70-80% to advanced process
Industry-first HBM4 IP test chip delivered
Industry's fastest HBM4E controller IP introduced
Hybrid-bonder development delayed industry-wide -> 20-high+ HBM needs a WIDER-die TC tool: WIDE TC BONDER launch imminent; hybrid bonders developed in parallel at dedicated Factory 7 (due 11-2026)
Cube Prober brings per-stack FULL inspection of HBM — higher stacking (HBM4, 16-20-high) structurally raises test intensity and time per device

tables.title: 800G → 1.6T optical
rows: 1.6T mass production ramps commence Q3 2026 with TWO hyperscalers; 10 active 1.6T programs surging 2027; 400G/800G still growing into 2027; 1.6T CPO switch samples 1H 2027, MP 2H 2027
First 1.6T transceiver volume order received; deliveries from Q3 2026; 800G ramping 4x QoQ
In at 3 of top-4 pluggable transceiver makers — 1.6T enabled now, roadmap 3.2T+
>850,000 400G and >75,000 800G coherent pluggables shipped to date (from >750k/>40k a quarter earlier); Acacia >$1bn of orders in Q4 alone
Cardinal 200G/lane DSP launched; Dust SiPho PICs span 800G/1.6T → 3.2T roadmap
800G/1.6T PAM4 driving module/cable production; 200G/lane photodetectors growing

1.6T TRIALS H2-2026 with single-digit VERY LARGE customers (liquid cooling required; 7060X-E7 100T switch, first liquid-cooled options); real production 2027 — mirrors 800G's trials-23/24 -> ramp-25/26; XPO form factor for 1.6T/3.2T era

tables.title: 54V/415V → 800V DC power
rows: Rubin-generation partnership scope is already 800V DC (per Eaton); 18.5kW PSUs end-2026

Power-architecture collaboration for the WORLD'S FIRST 800 VDC AI data center (NVIDIA Vera Rubin); validating at VisionBay.AI K1, Kaohsiung. Roadmap: 2026 DC-in-rack → 2027 800 VDC rack/pod → 2028+ native 800 VDC data hall (MV DC UPS or SST)
800V DC quotes out; ORDERS H2 2026; shipments late 2027-early 2028; ~10 SST pilots
20kW 800V→6V GaN platform (97.5% eff, NVIDIA MGX); GaN 800V ramp targeted 2027
Now SAMPLING high-voltage AC-to-DC for 800V data-center architectures, on MPS SILICON CARBIDE; own GaN device developed but 800V relies on SiC; revenue gated on when the DC transition happens
800V→12/6V stage-1 + VRM stage-2 ASSP sockets kick in H2 2026 → 2027 (GaN + Texas BCD)
1,250V + 1,700V GaN in NVIDIA 800V architectures; DC SAM >$1B by 2030
SST + 800V DC named the rationale for the CPI spin-off (grid-to-chip)
MV UPS (claims FIRST AND ONLY) = key building block of ABB's 800VDC architecture coming 'a year or two from now'; ZERO 800V orders in today's record DC bookings — all upside ahead
Gen-1 'power sidecar' ready-made solution; step-2 = compact integrated solution w/ partners; ramp 2028-2030, still limited share of total DC by 2030

12V + 6V architectures with NVIDIA = complete 800VDC portfolio for gigawatt-scale compute; Q2 added multiple Si + SiC power design wins and a LOW-voltage power/analog pipeline on top of the established high-voltage position
AI power ON ALLOCATION; avg content ~$175/kW (range $100-250); GaN ramping incl intermediate bus converters; solid-state transformers at first revenues
Already has 800V solutions — covered in a GPU maker's publication; grid-to-core incl 48V; 94B yen capex for in-house AI digital power (Kofu 300mm)
800VDC Power Rack enters validation H2 2026; 110kW power shelves already shipping; 8.5kW PSU/BBU scaling
400->800V high-voltage alu-electrolytic/MLCC/film caps (xEV heritage) + low-voltage high-current thin-film inductors for vertical power; AI-DC passives ~10x by FY2031

tables.title: Air → Liquid cooling
rows: 175MW direct-to-chip liquid-cooled live at Polaris Forge 1 (100MW + 75MW Building 2 Phase 1 RFS on schedule); 1.4GW contracted across five liquid-cooled AI Factory campuses
300MW liquid-cooled Horizon 1-4 at Childress (Microsoft); Horizon One handoff Q3 2026
DLC rack-scale GB300 NVL72 shipping; >6,000 racks/month capacity
First OEM with a Tomahawk-6-based 100% LIQUID-COOLED switch (fall 2026)

North Carolina liquid-cooled rack site completes Q4 FY2026, fully ramped by Jan 2027 (run-rate ~$1B/$2B/$3B over 1/2/3 yrs); global footprint +10%, most capacity live by early CY2027; Adani India platform targets multi-GW liquid-cooled rack manufacturing (FY2028)
$4B hyperscale chiller LTA CY27-29 ($165M upfront, <=$2bn/yr); FY26 DC sales $1.1bn (+73%); FY27 DC +60-80%
Large DLC GPU deployments (GB200/B300, Vera) biased to Arm; PowerRack turnkey
